name: Platform Engineering and Internal Developer Platforms
certifications: Certified Cloud Native Platform Engineering Associate (CNPA)

beginner.summary: For DevOps engineers, SREs, infrastructure engineers and developers moving into platform teams. Covers why platform teams exist, a lab with kind, Backstage and Argo CD, Team Topologies, platform as a product, reference architectures, the Backstage software catalog, software templates for golden paths, TechDocs, GitOps with Argo CD, infrastructure modules, team namespaces, shared CI pipelines, default observability, secrets and supply chain security, policy as code, developer experience, platform metrics, self-service infrastructure requests and platform support. Follows the CNPA exam domains.
prerequisites: Uses Git and a CI/CD tool
Deploys containers to Kubernetes with kubectl
Comfortable with YAML and the command line
outcomes: Explain platform engineering, Team Topologies and platform as a product
Build a catalog, golden path templates and TechDocs in Backstage
Deliver services with GitOps, shared pipelines, team namespaces, policies and default observability
Measure the platform with DORA metrics, adoption figures and developer feedback

intermediate.summary: For platform engineers who build and run an internal developer platform. Covers platform APIs with custom resources and operators, Crossplane v2 compositions, kro and KubeVela, Score workload specifications, Backstage plugins and the new frontend system, portal sign-in, permissions and catalog ingestion, golden path versioning, preview environments, multi-tenancy, Cluster API fleets, progressive delivery, supply chain controls, platform SLOs, scorecards, FinOps, AI workloads, MCP access for AI assistants, platform incident response and CNPA exam preparation.
prerequisites: Has built or used a golden path and a GitOps workflow
Writes Kubernetes manifests and Helm or Kustomize configuration
Comfortable reading TypeScript or Go for small extensions
outcomes: Build self-service platform APIs with Crossplane, kro or operators
Extend and secure Backstage for a whole organisation
Offer environments, tenancy, progressive delivery and supply chain controls as platform services
Run the platform with SLOs, scorecards, cost reports and incident reviews, and prepare for the CNPA exam

advanced.summary: For platform leads, architects and staff engineers who run platform engineering across an organisation. Covers platform strategy and investment cases, maturity assessment, multi-cloud and hybrid architecture, control plane engineering, security architecture, compliance automation, fleet-scale GitOps, platform performance and reliability, organisation-wide engineering metrics, AI-native platforms, platform interfaces, portal product evaluation, adoption at scale, team leadership, governance, regulated industries, inner source and CNPE exam preparation.
prerequisites: Has built or run an internal developer platform in production
Strong Kubernetes, GitOps and infrastructure as code experience
Responsible for platform design, a platform team or platform investment
outcomes: Set platform strategy, investment cases and operating models backed by evidence
Design multi-cloud control planes and security and compliance automation for fleets
Engineer platform performance, reliability and metrics programmes
Lead platform teams, governance, adoption and inner source, and prepare for the CNPE exam
